Specification: This module defines a small TLA+ specification used to exercise higher-order operator application, recursive-style finite-set folding through a LET-defined function, and TLC printing/assertion behavior. The state consists of a single variable x, initialized to 1, with a trivial next-state action that leaves x unchanged by assigning x' = x. The helper operator FApply folds an operator over the values of a function by recursively choosing elements from subsets of the function domain, printing trace strings during evaluation; the specification includes a test in Init that checks a multiplication fold over three values 3 gives 27, and it defines trivial invariant and constraint predicates.
IfThenElse: IF S = { } THEN Print("a", Identity) ELSE LET s == CHOOSE s \in S : TRUE IN Print("b", Op(f[s], fa[S \ {s}]))
IF FApply([i \in {"a", "b", "c"} |-> 3], *, 1) = 27 THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
